task.description:
Update documentation to mark PD-07 as RELEASED.

### Step 1: Update `docs/status/requirement_status.json`

Set `requirements.PD-07.status` to `"RELEASED"` and add `released_at` with the current ISO8601 UTC timestamp. Do NOT change any other requirements.

### Step 2: Update `CHANGELOG.md`

Add an entry under the current unreleased section (or create a new section if none exists):

```markdown
### Stage 2 — PD-07 — Definition retrieval (released 2026-05-21)

- Added `Store.getActiveByName()` to retrieve the currently ACTIVE version of a definition by name (`GET /definitions/active/:name`).
- Added `?stage=` filter support to `Store.list()` via new `stage` field in `ListOpts`.
- Added migration `014_definition_stage.sql` to add `stage` column to `process_definitions`.
- Implemented HTTP route handlers in `src/api/routes/definitions.zig`: `handleGetById`, `handleList`, `handleGetActiveByName`.
- API-06 cursor-based pagination implemented in `handleList` using base64url-encoded `created_at` timestamps.
- `?status=` and `?page_size=` validated at HTTP layer before reaching store.
```

### Step 3: Update `handoffs/registry.json`

Set the `status` field of entry `77100006-2605-4000-8007-202605210605` to `"COMPLETED"`.
acceptance_criteria: docs/status/requirement_status.json shows PD-07 status=RELEASED with released_at timestamp
CHANGELOG.md contains a PD-07 entry listing all key artifacts
No other requirements were modified in requirement_status.json
